title: CPA — Certified Public Accountant
price: ~$1,400 in exam and application fees (varies by state), plus a review course ($1,500–$3,000). Most states require 150 credit hours to be licensed.
desc: The license for public accounting. Start planning the 150-hour requirement in your sophomore year, not your senior year.

title: CMA — Certified Management Accountant
price: Student member ~$210/yr; exam ~$311 per part (2 parts), entrance fee ~$210.
desc: The corporate-side counterpart to the CPA. Cheaper, faster, and aimed at FP&A and internal reporting.

title: CIA — Certified Internal Auditor
price: Student rates available; roughly $1,000–$1,500 all in across three parts.
desc: The global standard for internal audit. Big 4 internal-audit and risk practices know it by name.

title: CFA Level I
price: Exam ~$1,140 with early registration or ~$1,490 standard; the one-time enrollment fee was dropped in 2026. Scholarships exist for students.
desc: The investment-management standard. Level I is sittable in your final year; ask about the Access Scholarship.

title: FRM — Financial Risk Manager
price: Enrollment ~$400 plus ~$600–$800 per part (2 parts).
desc: Market, credit, and operational risk. The usual credential for bank risk and treasury roles.

title: CFP — Certified Financial Planner
price: Exam ~$925; required coursework $3,000–$8,000 unless your degree is CFP-registered.
desc: For wealth management and advisory. Check whether your school's finance program is already CFP-registered — that removes the coursework cost.

title: CAIA — Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst
price: Enrollment ~$400 plus ~$1,000 per level (2 levels).
desc: Private equity, hedge funds, and real assets. Narrower than the CFA and well regarded in alternatives.

title: FMVA — Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst
price: ~$497–$847/yr for full access, with about 50% off for students using a school email. Individual courses often free to audit.
desc: Build a three-statement model and a DCF from scratch. The most practical paid option for banking interviews.

title: Wall Street Prep Financial Modeling
price: ~$500–$700 per package; heavy student discounts and campus site licenses.
desc: What many banks use for their own analyst training. Check whether your business school already has a license.

title: Bloomberg Market Concepts
price: Free through a school with Bloomberg terminals; otherwise ~$149.
desc: Economic indicators, currencies, fixed income, and equities on live terminal data. Check your library before paying.

title: Financial Markets
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Robert Shiller on risk, behavioral finance, and institutions. More than two million people have taken it.

title: Introduction to Financial Accounting
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Brian Bushee builds the three statements from transactions up. Do this before any modeling course.

title: Accounting Fundamentals
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Debits, credits, and how the three statements link, in a short course.

title: Introduction to Corporate Finance
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Time value of money, NPV, and cost of capital. The vocabulary every finance interview assumes.

title: Startup Valuation Methods
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: How early-stage companies are actually valued. Useful for VC and startup-finance interviews.

title: Excel training paths
price: Free.
desc: Formulas, pivot tables, and Power Query. The single most assumed skill in any business internship.

title: MOS: Excel Associate (MO-210)
price: Exam ~$100; often free or discounted through a campus testing center.
desc: A verifiable Excel credential rather than a line that says 'proficient in Excel'. Ask your career center about a voucher.

title: PL-300: Power BI Data Analyst
price: Training free; exam ~$165. Student discounts available.
desc: The training is free and the exam is not. The most recognized BI credential in corporate roles.

title: Salesforce Certified Tableau Desktop Foundations
price: $75 exam fee; retakes are free. Tableau is free for students through Tableau for Students.
desc: Tableau’s entry-level certification (formerly the Desktop Specialist): 40 questions and no prerequisites.

title: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Nine courses covering spreadsheets, SQL, R, and Tableau.

title: Intro to SQL
price: Free.
desc: SELECT through GROUP BY on real tables. Nobody in analytics escapes SQL.

title: Pandas
price: Free.
desc: Group-by, joins, and indexing. What analytics internships actually test.

title: Python
price: Free.
desc: Syntax to functions in a browser notebook. The on-ramp to everything else.

title: Data Visualization
price: Free.
desc: Which chart to reach for, and why. Pairs with Power BI or Tableau.

title: Alteryx SparkED (free student license + certification)
price: Micro-credentials and Designer Core exam are free; Alteryx is free for students via SparkED.
desc: Big 4 audit and consulting teams use Alteryx heavily. Free exam, free student license — unusually good value.

title: Google Analytics Certification
price: Free.
desc: GA4 setup, reporting, and attribution. The exam is free and renews annually.

title: Google Ads Search Certification
price: Free.
desc: Campaign structure, bidding, and keywords. A named credential on a marketing resume.

title: Inbound Marketing Certification
price: Free, certificate included.
desc: The inbound funnel and content strategy, free certificate and all.

title: Sales Enablement Certification
price: Free.
desc: CRM hygiene and pipeline mechanics. Useful in any role touching a sales team.

title: Meta Social Media Marketing Professional Certificate
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Paid social from the platform that sells it.

title: SEO and Content Marketing courses
price: Courses and exams are free.
desc: Free SEO certifications from a tool agencies actually use.

title: Salesforce Certified Administrator
price: Exam ~$200 (retake ~$100). All training on Trailhead is free.
desc: One of the most hireable business-tech credentials there is. The training costs nothing; only the exam does.

title: Salesforce Admin Beginner trail
price: Free.
desc: Objects, fields, and reports in a free developer org. Badges link straight to LinkedIn.

title: CAPM — Certified Associate in Project Management
price: Exam ~$225 for PMI members (membership ~$32 for students), ~$300 otherwise.
desc: The student-accessible PMI credential — no work experience required, unlike the PMP.
checkNote: pmi.org returns 403 to all automated requests; URL confirmed 200 by hand on 2026-09-21.

title: PSM I — Professional Scrum Master
price: Exam ~$200, no mandatory course. All Scrum.org learning material is free.
desc: Cheaper and more rigorous than the weekend CSM course, and it never expires.

title: Six Sigma Fundamentals
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available. ASQ belt exams are separate and paid.
desc: Process improvement for operations roles. Check whether your school runs its own belt first — it is usually much cheaper.

title: CPIM — Certified in Planning and Inventory Management
price: Exam $1,215 for ASCM members with the certification upgrade or $1,690 otherwise; the bundle with the learning system is $2,190 or $3,050.
desc: The supply-chain credential employers name directly in job postings.

title: Supply Chain Principles
price: Paid on Coursera; financial aid available.
desc: A proper introduction to the field from a top-ranked supply-chain school.

title: SHRM-CP
price: Exam $350–$499 depending on SHRM membership and registration date; students pay $150–$299. Student eligibility rules apply.
desc: The HR credential. Check the eligibility table early — it depends on your degree and experience.

title: Human Resource Management Specialization
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Hiring, performance, and pay across five courses.

title: CPCU — Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter
price: Roughly $3,500–$5,000 in total across 8 courses and exams; employers very often pay.
desc: The insurance industry's core designation. Almost always employer-funded once you are hired.

title: CTP — Certified Treasury Professional
price: Exam ~$1,050 ($795 members). Usually taken after a couple of years in role.
desc: Corporate treasury and cash management. Worth knowing about now, sitting later.

title: J.P. Morgan job simulations
price: Free.
desc: Investment Banking and Quantitative Research are the usual pair for a finance or analytics track.

title: Goldman Sachs job simulations
price: Free.
desc: Operations, Controllers, and Risk. Controllers pairs neatly with an accounting course.

title: BCG job simulations
price: Free.
desc: Strategy and data-science tasks scored against a real BCG rubric.

title: Deloitte job simulations
price: Free.
desc: Technology, audit, and analytics tracks from one of the Big 4. Usually the shortest sims on the site.

title: PwC job simulations
price: Free.
desc: Digital Intelligence and Audit tracks. The Power BI task pairs with the PL-300 path.

title: KPMG job simulations
price: Free.
desc: Data analytics and audit tracks from the fourth of the Big 4.

title: Citi job simulations
price: Free.
desc: A second bank sim alongside J.P. Morgan reads as deliberate rather than accidental.

title: Accenture job simulations
price: Free.
desc: Consulting, technology, and strategy tasks. Broad enough for most business majors.

title: Wharton Undergraduate Accounting Course Descriptions
price: Free to read.
desc: Not a certificate — a syllabus map. Sanity-check your own course plan against it.

title: AICPA student resources and the 150-hour rule
price: Free; student membership is free.
desc: Free student membership plus the state-by-state licensure rules. Read this before choosing your credit plan.

title: IMF free online courses
price: Free.
desc: Macroeconomic policy taught by IMF staff. Strong for economics and international business tracks.

title: Entrepreneurship 101 and 102
price: Free; no certificate.
desc: MIT's new-enterprises material in full. No certificate, but the content is the real thing.

title: Hotel Management: Distribution, Revenue and Demand
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: From Cornell's hospitality school. Revenue management is what turns a hospitality resume into an analytics one.

title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
price: Exam ~$100. All AWS Skill Builder training for it is free.
desc: The business-literate cloud credential. Common for MIS students heading into consulting or tech.

title: LinkedIn Learning via your library
price: ~$40/month retail, but free through most university and public libraries.
desc: Rarely worth paying for — check your university and public library cards first, where it is usually free.

title: VITA tax volunteer certification
price: Free. IRS Link & Learn training and the certification test cost nothing.
desc: Prepare real returns for real people at a campus or community site. One of the few accounting resume lines with genuine client work behind it.

title: EA — Enrolled Agent
price: Three exam parts at roughly $260–$270 each. No degree or experience requirement.
desc: The federal tax credential. Unlike the CPA it has no credit-hour rule, so it can be earned while still in school.

title: QuickBooks Online Certification
price: Free with a free QuickBooks Online Accountant account.
desc: The software most small-business clients run their books on. The certification is free and recruiters for small firms look for it.

title: CFE — Certified Fraud Examiner
price: Several hundred dollars in exam and membership fees; ACFE has student discounts.
desc: Forensic accounting and fraud investigation. The exam can be sat before you have the experience needed to hold the title.

title: CISA — Certified Information Systems Auditor
price: ~$575 for members, ~$760 for non-members. Student membership is cheap.
desc: Where accounting meets IT: auditing systems and controls. In demand at the Big Four for accounting and MIS majors alike.

title: SIE — Securities Industry Essentials exam
price: $100 exam fee. No firm sponsorship needed; you must be 18 or older.
desc: The one securities license exam a student can take without an employer. Passing it before recruiting signals commitment to banks and brokerages.

title: Aswath Damodaran’s valuation classes
price: Free — lectures, spreadsheets and data sets.
desc: The most-cited valuation teacher alive puts his entire course online. Use the data sets for any stock pitch.

title: Finance and capital markets
price: Free.
desc: Interest, bonds, stocks and mortgages from zero. A gentle start before Yale or Wharton.

title: Finance for Everyone Specialization
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Decisions, markets, value and debt — finance explained from first principles, with no prerequisites.

title: Sustainable Investing Certificate
price: USD 890, including the exam.
desc: CFA Institute’s ESG credential (formerly the Certificate in ESG Investing). Useful for asset-management and sustainability roles.

title: Google Advanced Data Analytics Professional Certificate
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: The step after Google Data Analytics: Python, statistics and regression models.

title: Google Business Intelligence Professional Certificate
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Dashboards, data models and pipelines — what a BI analyst builds all week.

title: IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Excel, SQL, Python and Cognos in one track. A good alternative to the Google certificate.

title: DP-900: Azure Data Fundamentals
price: Training free; exam ~$99, with student discounts.
desc: Relational, non-relational and analytics data on Azure. A cheap named credential for analytics and MIS majors.

title: Advanced SQL
price: Free.
desc: Joins, window functions and nested data. The SQL that interview case studies actually test.

title: Intro to Machine Learning
price: Free.
desc: Decision trees and validation in three hours. Enough to follow what the data scientists are talking about.

title: Data Analysis with Python
price: Free, including the certificate.
desc: Five projects that end in a free, verifiable certificate — and a portfolio to show for it.

title: Tableau for Students
price: Free one-year license for enrolled students.
desc: A free license to build the portfolio before paying for the Tableau exam.

title: SAS Skill Builder for Students
price: Free training and software; certification exams discounted for students.
desc: SAS still runs a great deal of banking, insurance and pharma analytics. Free for students.

title: CompTIA Data+
price: Exam ~$250+; academic pricing is available through many schools.
desc: A vendor-neutral data analytics credential, recognized by employers that do not use one particular tool.

title: R Programming
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: The language most economics departments and research roles expect.

title: AZ-900: Azure Fundamentals
price: Training free; exam ~$99, with student discounts.
desc: Cloud concepts and Azure services. Pairs with AWS Cloud Practitioner for consulting roles.

title: CompTIA Security+
price: Exam ~$400; academic pricing is available through many schools.
desc: The baseline security certification, required for many government and defense roles.

title: Salesforce Certified Platform Foundations
price: Training free on Trailhead; the exam has a fee — check Trailhead.
desc: The entry-level Salesforce credential (formerly Salesforce Associate) — a good first step before the Administrator exam.

title: SAP Learning journeys
price: Free learning journeys; certification exams are paid.
desc: SAP runs the finance and supply chain of most large companies. The learning journeys are free.

title: Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Professional Certificate
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Search, email, social and e-commerce in one track, with a Google name on the certificate.

title: Content Marketing Certification
price: Free.
desc: Planning, writing and repurposing content. Free, and the certificate is widely recognized.

title: Digital Marketing Certification
price: Free.
desc: A broad free survey of digital channels — a good first marketing certificate.

title: Social Media Marketing Certification
price: Free.
desc: Strategy, listening and reporting for social channels.

title: Ahrefs Academy SEO courses
price: Free.
desc: Practical SEO from the people who build the tool agencies use.

title: Google Project Management Professional Certificate
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Traditional and agile project management. Its hours count toward PMI’s CAPM education requirement.

title: PSPO I — Professional Scrum Product Owner
price: $200 assessment; no course required.
desc: The product-owner counterpart to PSM I. Worth having for product management internships.

title: CSSGB — Certified Six Sigma Green Belt
price: Several hundred dollars; ASQ members pay less.
desc: The recognized Six Sigma credential from the quality profession’s own body.

title: Leading People and Teams Specialization
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Motivation, team design and leading change. The management half of a business degree.

title: Generative AI for Everyone
price: Paid on Coursera; financial aid available.
desc: Andrew Ng on what generative AI can and cannot do for a business. Every interviewer is asking about it.

title: Excel Skills for Business Specialization
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: From first formula to lookups, pivot tables and dashboards. Pairs with the MOS exam.

title: MITx MicroMasters in Supply Chain Management
price: Courses free to audit; verified certificates cost extra per course.
desc: The most rigorous supply chain program available online, from MIT’s top-ranked center.

title: Supply Chain Management Specialization
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Logistics, operations, planning and sourcing, one course each.

title: CSCP — Certified Supply Chain Professional
price: Exam $1,390 for ASCM members with the certification upgrade or $1,940 otherwise; the bundle with the learning system is $2,515 or $3,505.
desc: The end-to-end supply chain credential. Usually employer-funded once you are hired.

title: aPHR — Associate Professional in Human Resources
price: About $400 ($100 application fee plus $300 exam). No HR experience required.
desc: The HR credential built for people with no experience yet — students included.

title: People Analytics
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: Using data for hiring, performance and retention decisions — the fastest-growing corner of HR.

title: SHRM student membership and resources
price: Student membership is heavily discounted.
desc: Student chapters, case competitions and the path to the SHRM-CP.

title: Macroeconomics
price: Free.
desc: GDP, inflation, monetary and fiscal policy. The vocabulary every markets interview assumes.

title: Microeconomics
price: Free.
desc: Supply, demand, elasticity and market structure — the logic behind every pricing question.

title: Marginal Revolution University
price: Free.
desc: Short, sharp economics videos from Tyler Cowen and Alex Tabarrok.

title: Federal Reserve Education
price: Free.
desc: How the Fed sets rates, straight from the Fed. Also runs the College Fed Challenge.

title: Startup School
price: Free.
desc: Y Combinator’s free course on building a startup, plus a co-founder matching service.

title: Free small-business counseling (SBA, SCORE, SBDCs)
price: Free.
desc: Free one-on-one mentoring and workshops from SCORE, Small Business Development Centers and the SBA. Use it before you write a business plan alone.

title: Entrepreneurship: Launching an Innovative Business
price: Paid on Coursera (included with Coursera Plus); financial aid available.
desc: From idea to launch: design thinking, business models and startup financing.

title: Learn How to Export
price: Free.
desc: The U.S. government’s own guide to exporting: markets, pricing, shipping and documentation.

title: CGBP — Certified Global Business Professional
price: Exam in the low hundreds of dollars; check NASBITE for the current fee.
desc: The recognized credential for international trade: management, marketing, supply chain and trade finance.

title: Exam P — Probability
price: Exam ~$275; check SOA for the current fee.
desc: The first actuarial exam. Passing it before graduation is close to a requirement for actuarial internships.

title: RIMS-CRMP
price: Several hundred dollars; RIMS has student pricing.
desc: The enterprise risk management credential from the risk managers’ professional body.

title: ServSafe Manager
price: About $179 for the online course and exam together; the exam alone is about $99.
desc: The food-safety certification most U.S. restaurants require of managers.

title: TIPS responsible alcohol service
price: About $40.
desc: Responsible alcohol service. Cheap, quick and asked for in hotel and restaurant jobs.

title: American Hotel & Lodging Educational Institute certifications
price: Varies by certification; many are under $100 for students.
desc: The hotel industry’s own certifications, from front-desk to revenue management.

title: Real estate salesperson license
price: Pre-license course plus state exam, usually a few hundred dollars. Rules vary by state.
desc: Every state licenses agents separately. ARELLO links to each state’s regulator and its requirements.

title: CCIM Institute courses
price: Courses in the hundreds of dollars; student pricing exists.
desc: Commercial real estate investment analysis. The full CCIM designation comes after experience; the courses do not need it.

title: PMP — Project Management Professional
price: Exam fee in the hundreds of dollars (PMI members pay less), plus 35 hours of required project management training.
desc: The best-known project management credential. It needs three years of project experience with a bachelor’s degree (two for graduates of PMI-accredited programs), so start with the CAPM as a student.
checkNote: pmi.org returns 403 to all automated requests; page confirmed in a browser on 2026-09-25.

title: CSM — Certified ScrumMaster
price: $250–$2,495 depending on the trainer; the price covers the 16-hour course and the test. Renew every two years.
desc: Scrum Alliance’s Scrum Master credential, earned through a live 16-hour course and a 50-question test. The PSM I is the self-study alternative.

title: PRINCE2 Foundation
price: Bought from PeopleCert or an accredited trainer; the price varies by country and by training bundle.
desc: The project management method used widely in the UK, Europe and government work. The Foundation level has no prerequisites.

title: ECBA — Entry Certificate in Business Analysis
price: $395 or less for IIBA’s package (membership, exam and a practice exam); students pay $315 or less depending on region.
desc: IIBA’s entry-level business analysis credential, built for students and career changers. No work experience needed.

title: CBAP — Certified Business Analysis Professional
price: $145 application fee plus a $350 exam for IIBA members or $450 for non-members.
desc: The senior business analysis credential. It needs 7,500 hours of business analysis work in the last ten years, so it is a goal for later; start with the ECBA.

title: ChFC — Chartered Financial Consultant
price: Eight courses from about $985 each; packages start at $6,545.
desc: A financial planning designation earned course by course, in as little as eight months. Using it requires three years of financial planning experience.

title: CMT — Chartered Market Technician (Level I)
price: $825 for the Level I exam at standard pricing, with the official curriculum included. Partner schools get reduced rates.
desc: The technical analysis credential for trading and markets roles, earned over three exam levels.
checkNote: cmtassociation.org shows a Cloudflare bot check to automated requests; URL taken from the CMT Association’s own site on 2026-09-25.

title: CAMS — Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist
price: Sold as a package (study materials, courses and exam) that needs an ACAMS membership; ACAMS lists current pricing.
desc: The anti-money-laundering credential for compliance roles at banks and fintechs. It needs 40 eligibility credits from education, experience and ACAMS training.
checkNote: acams.org shows a Cloudflare bot check to automated requests; URL taken from ACAMS’s own site on 2026-09-25.

title: FPAC — Certified Corporate FP&A Professional
price: $1,420–$1,520 for non-members (a year of membership included) or $1,025–$1,125 for AFP members, covering both exam parts.
desc: Budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis for corporate finance teams. Students in a finance, business or accounting major within two years of graduating can enroll.

title: CLTD — Certified in Logistics, Transportation and Distribution
price: Exam $1,055 for ASCM members with the certification upgrade or $1,470 otherwise; the bundle with the learning system is $1,900 or $2,650.
desc: ASCM’s logistics, transportation and distribution credential: one 150-question exam, about 100 hours of study.

title: CSSBB — Certified Six Sigma Black Belt
price: $585 for the exam; ASQ members pay $100 less.
desc: The advanced Six Sigma credential. It needs two completed projects, or one project plus three years of experience, in a full-time paid role; the Green Belt comes first.

title: AMA Professional Certified Marketer (PCM)
price: The Digital Marketing exam is $249 for AMA members or $349 otherwise; other PCM programs start at $749.
desc: The American Marketing Association’s credential, in digital marketing and other specialties. There are no formal eligibility requirements.

title: ARM — Associate in Risk Management
price: Priced per course; four courses, usually finished in six to nine months.
desc: The risk management designation from The Institutes. Its courses also count toward the CPCU.

title: PHR — Professional in Human Resources
price: $395 exam fee plus a $100 application fee.
desc: HRCI’s professional HR credential. It needs one to four years of professional HR work depending on your degree, so students start with the aPHR.

title: CMP — Certified Meeting Professional
price: $450 exam fee plus an application fee.
desc: The event-planning credential. It needs 24–36 months of industry work, and a 200-hour internship can meet its education requirement.

title: Investment Foundations Certificate
price: $79 for full-time students ($350 standard).
desc: CFA Institute’s introduction to the investment industry: self-paced, 35–65 hours, with a 100-question online assessment and no prerequisites.

title: CTSC — Certified in Transformation for Supply Chain
price: Sold only as a bundle for first-time test takers: $2,145 for ASCM members with the certification upgrade or $2,990 otherwise.
desc: ASCM’s certification on planning and leading supply chain transformation: one 150-question exam, about 100 hours of study.

title: Supply Chain Procurement Certificate
price: $495 for ASCM members or $695 otherwise, including the exam.
desc: Sourcing, supplier management, negotiation and procurement metrics. About 20 hours online and one exam; it never expires.

title: Supply Chain Warehousing Certificate
price: $495 for ASCM members or $695 otherwise, including the exam.
desc: Warehousing and distribution: inventory control, order fulfillment and shipping, built with Prologis. About 20 hours online and one exam; it never expires.

title: Supply Chain Planning Certificate
price: $495 for ASCM members or $695 otherwise, including the exam.
desc: Demand planning, master scheduling, material requirements and S&OP. About 20 hours online and one exam; it never expires.

title: Supply Chain Technology Certificate
price: $495 for ASCM members or $695 otherwise, including the exam.
desc: How blockchain, IoT, analytics and automation are used in supply chains. About 20 hours online and one exam; it never expires.

title: Supply Chain Resilience Certificate
price: $495 for ASCM members or $695 otherwise, including the exam.
desc: Supply chain risk management and planning for disruption. About 20 hours online and one exam; it never expires.

title: Supplier Relationship Management Certificate
price: $495 for ASCM members or $695 otherwise, including the exam.
desc: Building and managing long-term supplier relationships. About 20 hours online and one exam; it never expires.

title: CIPM — Certificate in Investment Performance Measurement
price: Two exams, from $675 each. No prerequisites to enroll.
desc: Measuring and explaining investment performance, over two levels of about 155 study hours each; usually finished within 18 months.

title: Private Markets and Alternative Investments Certificate
price: $890 standard price.
desc: Self-paced online certificate, 70–90 hours with six months of access.

title: Private Equity Certificate
price: $890 standard price.
desc: Self-paced, about 125 hours with 12 months of access. CFA Institute suggests the Private Markets certificate or CFA Level I first, but neither is required.

title: Climate Risk, Valuation, and Investing Certificate
price: $1,590 standard price.
desc: An intermediate, self-paced certificate of about 100 hours. The Sustainable Investing Certificate is the suggested starting point.

title: Series 3 — National Commodities Futures Exam
price: $140 exam fee. No firm sponsorship needed.
desc: The futures and commodities exam for people who sell futures, set by the National Futures Association.

title: Series 6 — Investment Company and Variable Contracts Products Representative Exam
price: $100 exam fee. A FINRA member firm must sponsor you, so it is taken after you are hired.
desc: For selling mutual funds, variable annuities and variable life insurance. To register you must also pass the SIE.

title: Series 7 — General Securities Representative Exam
price: $395 exam fee. A FINRA member firm must sponsor you, so it is taken after you are hired.
desc: The exam for brokers, traders and many banking roles. It is paired with the SIE, which you can pass on your own first.

title: Series 9 and 10 — General Securities Sales Supervisor Exams
price: $175 (Series 9) and $235 (Series 10) exam fees. A FINRA member firm must sponsor you, so it is taken after you are hired.
desc: For branch office sales supervisors (Series 9 and 10 together). To register you must also pass the SIE and the Series 7. A supervisor-level license, not a student credential.

title: Series 14 — Compliance Officer Exam
price: $350 exam fee. A FINRA member firm must sponsor you, so it is taken after you are hired.
desc: For compliance officers at broker-dealers. A supervisor-level license, not a student credential.

title: Series 16 — Supervisory Analyst Exam
price: $325 exam fee (Parts 1 and 2). A FINRA member firm must sponsor you, so it is taken after you are hired.
desc: For supervisory analysts, who review and approve research reports. A supervisor-level license, not a student credential.

title: Series 22 — Direct Participation Programs Representative Exam
